zh.title: 健康小贴士
zh.b1: 建议保持日常的口腔卫生习惯，包括每天两次的刷牙和使用牙线以维护种植牙和天然牙齿的健康。
zh.b2: 定期进行口腔检查，包括每半年一次的专业牙齿清洁，有助于延长种植牙的使用寿命。
zh.b3: 避免使用种植牙咬硬物，以防止种植体损伤或周围组织的问题。
zh.b4: 避免吸烟，因为吸烟会增加口腔疾病的风险，影响种植牙的稳定性和寿命。

en.title: Health tips
en.b1: Regular oral hygiene practices, including brushing twice daily and flossing, are recommended to maintain the health of both implants and natural teeth.
en.b2: Routine dental check-ups, including professional teeth cleaning every six months, can help to prolong the life of dental implants.
en.b3: Avoid using implants to bite on hard objects to prevent damage to the implant or surrounding tissues.
en.b4: Refrain from smoking, as it increases the risk of oral diseases and can affect the stability and lifespan of dental implants.
